# FitPlus

> India-first personal fitness coaching platform connecting independent trainers and clients.

FitPlus lets clients find a personal trainer, book consultations, follow daily
workout and nutrition plans, and check in weekly — all priced in INR. Trainers
get a single workspace to manage clients, build plans, track progress and earn.

## Stable public pages

- Homepage: https://fitplus-kappa.vercel.app/
- How it works: https://fitplus-kappa.vercel.app/welcome
- Trainer directory: https://fitplus-kappa.vercel.app/discover
- Privacy policy: https://fitplus-kappa.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms of service: https://fitplus-kappa.vercel.app/terms
